body:
## Why

Each agent should run on its own model and effort level, so a change to one agent's model or effort can be tried and evaluated on its own. Today the settings have `coordinatorModel`, and one `workerModel` (`claude-sonnet-5-5`) that #60 added for every worker. No agent sets an effort level, so each runs at its model's default. The Agent SDK's `AgentDefinition` takes both a `model` and an `effort` (`"low"` to `"max"`, or a number), so each agent's definition can carry its own.

## Design

- [Technical spec](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/technical-spec.md), section 6.5 (each agent's definition, and why its model is set) and section 10 (settings).
- `src/config/settings.schema.ts`, `src/agent/coordinator-definition.ts`, `src/agent/stay-researcher-definition.ts`.

## Open questions

- **Are the leg scout's and weather worker's settings added here, or with #61 and #64?** Proposed: with #61 and #64, since a setting with no agent to read it can't be checked, and each of those issues adds its agent's definition. This issue adds a line to each of their Do sections.
- **Does the coordinator's effort go in its definition, the query's options, or both?** The coordinator is the session's main agent, and technical spec 6.5 sets its model in both, so nothing depends on which one the SDK reads. Effort likely needs the same. Check it against the SDK.
- **What effort does each agent start at?** Proposed: each model's default, written out, so this issue changes nothing the agents do, and a later change is a one-line diff to evaluate.

## Do

- Replace `workerModel` with a model setting and an effort setting for each agent that exists: the coordinator and the stay researcher. `claude-sonnet-5-5` stays the stay researcher's model.
- Pass each agent's model and effort into its definition.
- Show each agent's model and effort in its view file, so a PR's diff shows the change.
- Write the settings into technical spec section 10, and the reason into 6.5.

## Done when

- Each agent's view file shows its model and effort, read from the settings.
- A test shows a changed setting reaches that agent's definition, and no other agent's.

## Ends in

A PR.

**Settled in:** chat.
